extraction_report.paper_summary: PPLM is a paired-protein language model that jointly encodes residue relationships across two sequences and is used for three downstream tasks: binary PPI prediction (PPLM-PPI), binding affinity estimation (PPLM-Affinity), and inter-protein contact / interface prediction (PPLM-Contact / PPLM-Contact2).
extraction_report.research_objective: Learn pair-aware sequence representations to (1) predict whether two proteins interact, (2) estimate binding affinity, and (3) predict inter-protein contacts/interface residues, all from sequence (with optional structural/MSA inputs).
identified_experiments: PPLM-PPI: binary interaction prediction between two sequences
PPLM-Affinity: binding affinity estimation from paired sequences
PPLM-Contact / PPLM-Contact2: inter-protein contact and interface residue prediction (with MSA and optional predicted complex structure features)
